title: Bad Beat of the Week: an Under undone in overtime
summary: Tied 6–6 after three quarters, Cleveland and New Orleans finished 23–22 in overtime. The 45 combined points beat a documented pregame Under 42.5 ticket by 2.5 points.
preview: A November 6 snapshot showed just 22% of tickets but 92% of money on Under 42.5; those percentages were not closing splits.

timeline.label: After three quarters
timeline.text: The Browns and Saints were tied 6–6, with only 12 combined points.

timeline.label: End of regulation
timeline.text: Each team scored 10 points in the fourth quarter; the game went to overtime tied 16–16.

timeline.label: Overtime
timeline.text: New Orleans scored seven and Cleveland scored six. The Saints won 23–22 and the final total reached 45.

unusual: A low-scoring game that had only 12 points through three quarters produced 33 points thereafter. The late scores flipped a documented Under 42.5 outcome.
explanations: Football overtime and late-game scoring can abruptly change a total. The large ticket/handle split came from one pregame source and is not evidence of insider knowledge or manipulation.
questions: The 22% tickets / 92% handle snapshot was collected November 6 and may have changed before kickoff.
Other sportsbooks offered different totals; this brief grades only a documented 42.5 line.

betting.provenance: CLEATZ published Under 42.5 on November 6, with 22% of tickets and 92% of handle on the Under in its tracked snapshot.
betting.caution: Book, price and timing matter. Percentages are one source's Friday snapshot, not a verified closing-market consensus.

potential_bets.impact: 45 final points means a loss, despite the 6–6 score through three quarters.
